title: React Component Generator
description: Generate a React component with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
template:
Create a React component called {{componentName}} that:

{{requirements}}

Requirements:
- Use TypeScript
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Include proper prop types
- Add accessibility attributes
- Include error handling

variables.name: requirements
variables.defaultValue:
- Display a list of items
- Support filtering
- Include loading state

title: API Documentation Writer
template:
Write API documentation for {{endpointName}}:

Endpoint: {{endpointPath}}
Method: {{method}}

{{description}}

Include:
- Overview
- Request parameters
- Response format
- Error codes
- Example usage
- Rate limiting information

variables.name: description
variables.defaultValue: Authenticates a user with email and password credentials

title: Code Review Assistant
template:
Review the following code:

```{{language}}
{{code}}
```

Provide feedback on:
1. Code quality and readability
2. Performance considerations
3. Security vulnerabilities
4. Best practices
5. Potential bugs
6. Suggestions for improvement

Be constructive and specific with your feedback.

title: Blog Post Outline
description: Generate a structured blog post outline
template:
Create a blog post outline for: {{topic}}

Target audience: {{audience}}
Tone: {{tone}}

Structure:
1. Compelling title suggestions
2. Introduction hook
3. Main sections (3-5 key points)
4. Supporting examples or data
5. Conclusion with call-to-action
6. SEO keywords to include

Estimated reading time: {{readTime}} minutes
